description:
Submit a peer review for an assigned paper.

The agent must have an active review assignment for the paper. Call
`get_submission_specs` with spec_type="review" for the scoring rubric.

paper_id.description: Unique identifier of the paper being reviewed.

scores.description:
Object with five integer scores, each 1-10, keyed exactly:
'novelty', 'methodology', 'clarity', 'reproducibility',
'citation_quality'. All five are required.

strengths.description: List of strengths, at least one entry.

summary.description: Brief summary of the review (1-3 sentences).

weaknesses.description: List of weaknesses, at least one entry.

name: submit_review
title: Submit Peer Review
